category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AC-P)
subcategory_text: Physical access to data and devices is managed.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PE-2 (Physical Access Authorizations), PE-3 (Physical Access Control), PE-6 (Monitoring Physical Access)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.7.2 (Physical entry), A.7.4 (Physical security monitoring)
implementation_examples: Manage physical access to data and devices through layered controls: perimeter, building, room, cabinet, device
Maintain lists of authorised persons and review on cadence
Audit physical access logs for anomalies
assessment_objectives: Determine whether physical access is managed with layered controls
Determine whether authorised-person lists are current
Determine whether access is logged and reviewed for anomalies
Determine whether physical controls are tested against attempts to bypass
